data.name: Asbahaa
data.gender_notes: Asbahaa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'asbah', meaning dawn or morning. This name holds spiritual significance as it refers to the start of a new day and the emergence of light. The name Asbahaa carries the meaning “Morning” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Asbahaa usually hope their child will grow to embody morning and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Asbahaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Morning.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asbahaa total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hindi.name: अशबाअ
in_hindi.meaning: अल्लाह ने जो कुछ भी बनाया है, उसकी कीमती चीजें ही सब कुछ है
in_hindi.long_meaning: अशबाअ नाम का अर्थ है अल्लाह ने जो कुछ भी बनाया है, उसकी कीमती चीजें ही सब कुछ है, यह नाम उन लोगों को दिया जाता है जो अल्लाह के खजानों में सबसे अधिक हैं और उनकी ख्वाहिशों को पूरा करते हैं।

in_english.name: Asbahaa
in_english.meaning: Allah's abundance and sufficiency for all His creation
in_english.long_meaning: The name Asbahaa is derived from the Arabic root 'ashbaa' which means to be abundant and sufficient. It is a name that reflects Allah's boundless generosity and provision for all of His creation, and is often used to describe the blessings and favors that Allah grants to His servants.
